description: Items used on blocks: a shovel making a path the player then walks onto, a hoe making farmland, an axe stripping a log, flint and steel lighting the floor, bone meal on a grass block, honeycomb on copper, a water bottle on dirt, a lily pad on water, powder snow from its bucket.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

build: item replace entity @a hotbar.0 with minecraft:iron_shovel
item replace entity @a hotbar.1 with minecraft:iron_hoe
item replace entity @a hotbar.2 with minecraft:iron_axe
item replace entity @a hotbar.3 with minecraft:flint_and_steel
item replace entity @a hotbar.4 with minecraft:bone_meal 8
item replace entity @a hotbar.5 with minecraft:honeycomb 4
item replace entity @a hotbar.7 with minecraft:lily_pad 4
item replace entity @a hotbar.8 with minecraft:powder_snow_bucket
harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
